### Destroying the Sting of Death
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/destroying-the-sting-of-death
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:53-57
Points:
- Christ's resurrection guarantees that death does not have the final say over believers.
- At the last trumpet, the mortal will put on immortality and death will be swallowed up in victory.
- Jesus removed the sting of death by atoning for sin and freeing believers from the law's condemnation.
- Christians do not need to fear death, because it merely transitions them into the presence of Christ.

### Work for the Lord
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/work-for-the-lord-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:58
Points:
- Believers are charged to stand firm and devote themselves entirely to the work of the Lord.
- Everyday jobs and ordinary duties are forms of divine service when carried out for Jesus.
- Diligence and integrity in our work reflect Christ's example of humble servanthood.
- Christians can endure difficult circumstances knowing that their labor in the Lord is never futile.
